full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

measurementRules.rule: Calibrated scale measures complete heads net of tare for the actual drawing/configuration/moisture window; Q sums unique new first-release mass. No catalogue per-item mass or assumed dry basis.
Keep original raw without division; convert each numerator to its own native extensive unit before real attribution and the sole quotient. Mass/kg never replaces MJ/m3/h.
Actual kWh converts once using3.6 MJ/kWh. Native group is energy rather than mass; no extra efficiency or heat purchase is inferred.

Do not multiply an integrated volume by time; integrate true rates only. A mass bridge requires independently evidenced composition/phase/temperature/pressure/density of the same substance. Water-in-air native volume is not kg; liquid-water density cannot stand for gas/preparation/effluent.

When count is actually used, Item(s) and item are physically equivalent with factor1. Per-item-to-kg requires calibrated measured net complete-head M for the same configuration/moisture/range, never secondary-property-inferred mass/density. Q remains actual kg.

Nonreference cards invoke single_quotient once. Gross A is complete V; manufacture A is attributed load with only unassigned inherited adjustment; service uses original Qc/observed H. Protocols/aggregation never divide again; Q=0 retains loads without a unit result.

calculationRules.rule: x = A / Q. This is the sole normalization after original-unit/true-rate conversion and real attribution. For each gross card A = V, the complete actual gross physical leg in its own native unit, without stock correction, burden vector, economic/service scaling or extra procurement/provider load/credit. For manufacture burden A is actual attributed converted raw load plus unassigned inherited opening per-exchange vector minus only still-unassigned closing vector and only one justified true other-function/cohort handover; already-net consumption is not corrected again and released closing FG is never deducted. Service and postrelease gross use Q = original Qc with observed H; service A carries only unused/unassigned charge and never deducts already performed service due to stored FG. Cohort burden cards select actual manufacturing Q or original Qc/H by event, with one attribution. Q=0 retains raw load without x; finished is exactly1 kg. Cards and aggregation only reference this same quotient and never divide again.

measurementRules.rule: 校准秤按真实图纸/配置/含水窗口逐批测量完整头部净质量并去皮，唯一新增首次放行量之和为Q；无目录单件重量或假定干重。
原始raw不先除；分别换算至本卡原生广延单位，再做真实归属和唯一商。不得将Mass/kg套给MJ、m3或h。
真实kWh按3.6 MJ/kWh换算一次；原生为能量单位组，不能误写质量单位组，不额外推定效率或热量采购。
已积分体积不再乘时间；只有真实速率才积分。质量桥须同一物质独立测量/取证的组成、相、温度、压力及密度。水在空气资源的原生体积不冒作kg；液水密度不套气体/制剂/废水。
仅当真实使用计数时，Item(s)与item物理等价因子1；每件转kg须校准称量同配置完整净头M，声明含水及范围，不从次级属性推单件kg或密度。Q仍为真实kg。
非参考卡只引用single_quotient一次；毛A是完整V，制造A是归属及仅未分配继承修正后负荷，服务用原Qc/已观测H。协议和aggregation不另除，Q=0保留负荷不出单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: x = A / Q. 这是原始单位/真实速率换算及真实归属后的唯一归一化。每张gross卡的A=完整实际毛实物腿V，按本卡原生单位，不做库存、负荷向量、经济份额或服务份额修正，也不产生采购/供方负荷/信用。manufacture负荷A=真实归属换算raw负荷+未分配期初逐交换继承向量-仅仍未分配期末向量-仅一次正当其他功能/批次移交；已净消耗不二扣，已放行期末FG不扣。service及放行后gross用Q=原Qc并保留已观测H，服务A仅结转未使用/未分配份额；已执行服务不因留库减去。cohort负荷卡按真实事件选制造Q或原Qc/H，只一次归属。Q=0保留原负荷无x；finished恒为1千克。卡片和aggregation均仅引用本次商，不再次除。
